home: A hut in the swamp, several hours southwest of Nebruz
appearance: Human female; full description not yet established at the table
and_yet: Brews potions and pursues ring-lore with the steady patience of a craftsman, not the urgency of a power-seeker
wants: Peace between the lizard-man tribes; freedom to pursue ring-lore; outsiders who respect swamp politics
does_not_want: Tribal war in the Luric marches; outsiders treating the swamp as enemy territory
oddly_also: Maintains a close friendship with Dorota of Nebruz — an unusual trust neither explains
pc_leverage: Deliver the upland herbs from Mother Yaleth (done, session 27); retrieve giant constrictor snake brain fluid for ring-lore; demonstrate respect for lizard-man tribal politics and the swamp's balance

current_business.brew: Water-breathing potions for the party (4-day brew)
current_business.ingredient_needed: Giant constrictor snake brain fluid — party tasked with retrieval (session 27)
current_business.dm_notes: Load-bearing for two arcs: the water-breathing brew (4-day clock) and the constrictor hunt (session 28 driver). Diplomatic keystone of the Luric marches — her neutrality prevents lizard-man tribal war and keeps tribes from raiding Caelrun.
